_doc: Headwaters source registry - Mumbai/MMR episodic sources. Schema + design notes: docs/specs/headwaters.md (local). CADENCE + TIER ARE DOCUMENTATION ONLY - decided 2026-07-26. Neither gates polling: every non-ciBlocked entry is fetched on every weekly run whatever its declared cadence (48 HTTP requests per CI run across ~26 hosts). Deliberate. (1) Cadence is a CLAIM and claims are wrong - CPCB is 'yearly' and shipped a mid-year Yamuna-only file, BBMB was recorded frozen and had resumed, CHIRPS looked daily and publishes monthly; gating polls on a declared cadence inherits every such error and stops looking at exactly the source that surprised you. (2) A conditional check is a check that can silently stop - the WRIS 'green for 39 days while ingesting nothing' bug lives in skip logic. (3) Interval scheduling is maintenance overhead for no real saving at this volume. Cadence earns its place at REVIEW time instead: it tells you whether a detection is plausible - a 'yearly' source producing a new edition three weeks after the last is itself a signal.

sources.notes: BMC's Environment Status Report is the widest-reach single document on the Mumbai side: the 4,000 vs 4,505 MLD supply pair, per-source yield (Table 9.1) and the sewage figures (Table 11.5: 2,723 MLD installed vs 1,313 reaching plants) all come from it, and it feeds four artifacts. Verified 2026-07-26: 200 with BOTH ETag and Last-Modified (20 Aug 2025), so http-meta is solid. LIMIT: the filename carries the year (Environment Status Report 2024-25), so next year's edition is a NEW url - needs the url-template method (P5-9) or a hand bump. Watch this one closely: it is the highest-fan-out document in the registry. MIGRATED to url-template 2026-07-26 (P5-9 shipped): probes the ESR filename forward by year, so next year's edition is detected on publication. This matters more here than anywhere else - the ESR is the highest fan-out document in the registry, feeding four artifacts.

The Deputy Hydraulic Engineer (Bhandup Complex) RTI manual is the primary source for Mumbai's water-supply engineering chain in mumbai-supply-overview.json. Verified 2026-07-26: 200 with ETag and Last-Modified (24 May 2021 - the document is stable, which is why tier 0). NOTE the path: BMC's own spelling is 'Hydrallic Engineer', not 'Hydraulic', and the URL needs the full ...(Bhandup Complex)/DyHydraulicEngineer_BhandupComplex_RTI_E01.pdf tail - the directory alone 404s. That truncation is what made this look dead in the first link sweep.

sources.notes: Mumbai Climate Action Plan - the policy parent of the Climate Budget commissioning table that commitments-mumbai.json cites for its on-track statuses. Chosen as the watch target because its CKAN slug is STABLE. The annual Climate Budget itself lands inside year-slugged datasets (bmc-budget-2024-25, -2025-26, -2026-27 - verified 2026-07-26, 22/27/24 resources respectively), so no single url can follow it across years; that needs the url-template method (P5-9). My first attempt at this entry guessed the slug 'mumbai-climate-budget', which 404s - it does not exist. Watched via OpenCity because mcgm.gov.in has no stable budget listing path. LICENCE: OpenCity CKAN package_show returns license_id 'other-pd' / license_title 'Other (Public Domain)' with no license_url and no grant text, and the PDF/data resources carry the same 'Public Domain' string (package AND resource level both checked, verified 2026-07-31). This records what the CKAN metadata SAYS; it is not a finding that the material is in the public domain. No upstream publisher ever issued a public-domain dedication, and OpenCity's own site-wide terms (opencity.in/terms-and-conditions) say 'Data are licensed under: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and ODbL' and permit download 'for non-commercial and / or personal use only', which contradicts the per-dataset label.

sources.notes: Ground Water Year Book of Maharashtra - backs 53 wells across Mumbai City/Suburban/Thane/Palghar/Raigad with water chemistry. Mumbai City and Suburban are the only 2 of Maharashtra's 35 districts EXCLUDED from the CGWB Dynamic Assessment, so this hydrograph series is all we have. Verified 2026-07-26 by opening the PDF: 246 pages, 'GROUND WATER YEAR BOOK OF MAHARASHTRA (2022-2023)', ETag + Last-Modified present, so http-meta works on the document itself. Same family limit as cgwb-yearbook-tn: NO listing page enumerates Year Books, so a NEW edition will not be detected by this entry - it only catches a re-upload of the 2022-23 file. The 2024-25 edition cited in mumbai-cgwb-stations.json (cgwbpnm/download/2016) is 404 and remains an OPEN TRACE. TLS: cgwb.gov.in serves an INCOMPLETE CERT CHAIN - Node fetch fails with UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE while curl succeeds (its CA bundle is broader). insecureTLS is required here; discovered when the first --accept errored 'fetch failed' on 2026-07-26. LISTING FOUND 2026-07-26 (corrects an earlier note in this entry): cgwb.gov.in/cgwbpnm/ IS a browsable publication warehouse - 171 download/<id> links with titles, dates and a state filter - so a Year Book listing DOES exist and this entry now watches it. A new edition appears as a new download id. RETRIEVAL IS BROKEN THOUGH: every download/<id>, publication-detail/<id> and thumbnail-derived path returns 404, including ids CGWB itself links (verified on 2015/2016/2023 with and without a referer). Only the opaque public/uploads/documents/<id>file.pdf form works, and those ids are not exposed in the listing.  CONFIRMED PRESENT: 'Ground Water Year Book Maharashtra (2024-2025)', posted 23 Mar 2026, publication id 2016 - which is exactly the download/2016 url mumbai-cgwb-stations.json cited. The id was RIGHT; CGWB's download endpoint is what is broken. RETRIEVAL IS BROKEN AT CGWB'S END - established 2026-07-26, do not repeat this. The publications warehouse at cgwb.gov.in/cgwbpnm/ LISTS both 2024-25 Year Books with titles, posting dates and publication ids, but there is no working public route to the PDFs. Eight automated routes were tried and all return the same 33 KB Drupal 404 ('paged nahin mila', plain openresty HTTP/2 404 - no WAF, no captcha, no challenge): download/<id>; publication-detail/<id>; the CSRF POST to publication/<id> followed by the download, replicating the site's own downloadPdf() JS; a cookie-jar session; deriving the path from the thumbnail id; a directory listing on uploads/documents/; search engines (not indexed); and the retired /Regions/<REGION>/Reports/ path. CONFIRMED IN A REAL BROWSER by the maintainer the same day: the page renders and the publications are visible, but the download does not work there either. So this is NOT a bot block, NOT a session problem and NOT something a browser fetch solves - an earlier version of this note said 'fetch it from a browser session', which was wrong. Only /cgwbpnm/ itself and /cgwbpnm/public/* static assets serve; every other route under /cgwbpnm/ 404s, which looks like a reverse-proxy misconfiguration on their side. The id scheme is <unix-seconds><random>, verified three ways (1688105823 = 30 Jun 2023 matches the 2017-18 PDF's own creation timestamp; 1774431953 and 1774326882 match the two 2026 posting dates), but the thumbnail and the PDF get DIFFERENT random suffixes, so the path cannot be derived from anything the listing exposes. NEXT STEPS, in order: (1) the cgwb-yearbook-* registry entries watch the download/<id> link set, so a re-upload or a route fix changes the set and we get told; (2) failing that, email CGWB SECR Chennai / CR Nagpur, or RTI. Not an engineering problem. LICENCE: read verbatim from cgwb.gov.in/en/website-policies (verified 2026-07-31; the host needs TLS verification disabled). This is the liberal GIGW template and it SUPERSEDES the older CGWB position that required permission from Member(SAM).

sources.notes: Government Resolutions are the paper behind the MMR allocation ledger: BMC's Bhatsa share (GR 11-Sep-2019, 427.93 Mm3/yr) and the Barvi sharing GR 18-Sep-2017 among them. The orgpedia mahGRs GitHub mirror is the only way to full-text-search Maharashtra GRs; WRD's own site does not expose them stably. Verified 2026-07-26: the directory listing returns 200. Caveat: GitHub tree pages are partly JS-rendered and paginate above 1,000 files, so if the link-set comes back thin, switch to the GitHub contents API (api.github.com/repos/orgpedia/mahGRs/contents/GRs/Water_Resources_Department) with api-date on the commit date. Named gaps that stay unwatched because they are not public at all: the MWRRA entitlement register (page literally 'Under Construction'), STEM's Thane/Bhiwandi split, MIDC per-buyer quantities.

MPCB's per-STP inventory plus the annual Water Quality Reports back industrial-sources-mumbai.json: 14 sewage-treatment points across the MMR, with the 9 MCGM plants carrying per-STP inlet/outlet BOD from Praja's 2024 RTI series (four - Versova, Bhandup, Ghatkopar, Malad - consistently fail the discharge standard). Sibling entry mpcb-water-quality-reports already watches the river-quality side; this one covers the STP/discharge side, which was unwatched. Verified 2026-07-26: page 200, and Final_WQR_22_23.pdf is among the linked documents. The pattern is deliberately broad because MPCB files documents under inconsistent directories; tighten if it proves noisy.
